name: R. Dandekar
evidence: Row is an irresolvably conflated entity, so the namesake rule blocks any assignment. arXiv 2410.01811 ('Evaluating Cultural Awareness of LLMs for Yoruba, Malayalam, and English') lists SIX authors, TWO of whom are distinct real people abbreviating to 'R. Dandekar': Raj Abhijit Dandekar and Rajat Dandekar, both affiliated with Vizuara AI Labs. The repo seed data confirms the conflation: seed/cdeval_pool.json lists 'R. Dandekar' twice under one and the same Semantic Scholar authorId 2320313160, and that S2 author record maps to DBLP identities ['Raj Abhijit Dandekar','Raj Dandekar','Rajat Dandekar'] - i.e. two separate researchers merged into one row. Anchors found but not usable for disambiguation: LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/raj-abhijit-dandekar-67a33118a (Vizuara, MIT PhD) exists and is a genuine Vizuara person, but attaching it would arbitrarily pick one of the two co-authors; Rajat Dandekar is an equally valid referent. Email: the full arXiv HTML of 2410.01811v1 was fetched and grepped - it prints NO email address for any author, only the shared 'Vizuara AI Labs' affiliation, and no per-person address was found on a printed source; a templated or org-level guess is forbidden. Recommendation: split this row into two people before enrichment.
